title: MaxSup: Overcoming Representation Collapse in Label Smoothing

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The theorem claims: 'LLS ≈ α ( zgt − (1/K) ∑_{k=1}^K zk ) − log ∑_{j=1}^K e^{z_j}'. However, the correct decomposition (shown in Appendix B) gives L_LS = α(z_gt − (1/K)∑ z_k) exactly, with no log-sum-exp term. The extra '− log ∑ e^{z_j}' is erroneous and contradicts the proof in the same paper.

The text states: 'using the widely adopted MMSegmentation framework [6].' Reference [6] is 'Yingbo Gao et al. Towards a better understanding of label smoothing in neural machine translation. AACL-IJCNLP 2020', which has nothing to do with MMSegmentation. The correct reference for MMSegmentation is omitted and the citation is misattributed.

The paper writes 'Building on Theorem 3.2' to refer to the previous decomposition, but that result is introduced as Lemma 3.2. The inconsistent use of 'Theorem' vs 'Lemma' for the same statement can confuse readers and should be corrected.
